verdict.line: You lose if you fight Riven with W (Indestructible) down before level 6; you win if you hold W for her all-in and convert with R once it's up.

brief.thesis: This matchup sits at 51.4% over 430 games because both champions win different windows: Riven's Q (Broken Wings) and W (Ki Burst) give her a burst all-in the moment she hits level 2-3, while Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp) into R (Realm of Death) lets him drag her into a 1v1 she can't dash or block her way out of. Solo-kill advantage favors you specifically because her all-in is telegraphed by resource-less cooldowns you can track, and yours isn't.

theirWindow.what: Riven can Ki Burst (W, stuns nearby enemies) into Broken Wings (Q, three reactivations, third hit knocks back) for a full burst all-in. If she lands the W stun while your W (Indestructible) is on cooldown, disengage rather than trade — OP.GG's own read on this matchup is not to fight her with W down.

yourWindow.when: your W up, her E on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Valor (10-6s CD depending on rank) down, Riven has no damage-block dash. Open with E (Death's Grasp, pulls all enemies in the area) to drag her in, then Q (Obliterate, bonus damage on a single target) — this is your all-in window, especially once R is up at 6.

playing.title: Hold W for her all-in
playing.detail: Never trade with Indestructible (W) on cooldown. If she opens Ki Burst (W) without it up, disengage — this is the single biggest swing factor in the matchup.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown
playing.detail: Valor (10/9/8/7/6s) is her only way to dodge or block your Q and E. When it's down, she has no escape from your pull — this is your all-in signal.

playing.title: Land 3 hits before committing
playing.detail: Darkness Rise (passive) gives you a damage aura and Move Speed after 3 landed attacks or spells. Bait out a trade first, then commit once it's active.

playing.title: Pull, don't chase
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (E) pulls all enemies in its area to you — use it to close distance on her dash instead of walking into Broken Wings range.

playing.title: Buy Bramble Vest if behind
playing.detail: If you're losing lane trades, Bramble Vest's grievous wounds directly counters her sustain and slows her snowball, per the matchup data.

playing.title: Save R for isolation kills
playing.detail: Realm of Death (R, 140-80s cooldown) drags only her into your dimension and steals her stats if you kill her — use it once your W and E are both available so she can't escape or burst you first.

playing.title: Play for the solo kill
playing.detail: Data shows Mordekaiser holds the solo-kill advantage in this matchup — look to isolate her away from her jungler using E's pull rather than fighting near river or brush.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the tell, power curve, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own read on the ability interactions, not measured data.
